g.data-name: stat_label · Your ratings, and the reason you give fo

g.text: Your ratings, and the reason you give for a Not useful or Wrong, become short lessons the analyst reads before each log it's relevant to. Each one is scored by your later ratings. When the analyst keeps ignoring an Avoid lesson, code enforces it and
leaves those findings out (never a fault).

g.data-name: stat_value · Avoid: A reading that's normal (within l

g.text: Avoid: A reading that's normal (within limits, no event, nothing detected) is not a finding. When nothing needs attention, write one all-clear finding instead.
